findings.finding: The cover story assumes the craft is the family's secret, but the revised Episode 1 shows a five-storey craft whose arrival the whole town watched.
evidence: fact: villagers in the bazaar watched the object and felt one enormous impact (e1:s2)
fact: the craft is about five storeys high (e1:s4)
findings.proposal: Episode 2's lines still play: the town saw something fall but not the boy. The bigger problem is Episode 3's storm-cellar reveal, which cannot hide a five-storey craft. Decide before Episode 3: the craft sinks into the earth, the authorities fence the site, or the craft is made small again.

findings.finding: The boy wears Devendra's checked shirt, so Devendra cannot also wear it in the kitchen.
evidence: fact: Devendra wears the faded red-and-navy checked shirt (from e1:s3, still valid)
findings.proposal: Close the shirt fact for Devendra at the start of Episode 2 and give him a plain off-white cotton vest with a grey gamchha over one shoulder for the kitchen. Suman keeps her sage-green kameez with the dupatta off.

findings.finding: The script matches 'the same little hand that held Suman's', but Episode 1's final picture is the boy's face with glowing eyes, not his hand.
evidence: key frame: episode final_picture shows the boy chest-up, eyes glowing
key frame: s4 first shows the boy's hand in Suman's
findings.proposal: Match from Episode 1's hand-hold frame (scene 4) to the hand reaching for गुड़. For the trailer or recap, the cut runs: glowing eyes, hands, kitchen hand.

findings.finding: The bridge crash puts two protected characters, Veer and Yash, in a violent accident and ends on Veer floating motionless underwater.
evidence: character veer: protected (no adult age stated; 17 in this scene)
character yash: protected (child in 2014, so about 17 in 2026)
findings.proposal: Treat it as non-graphic peril: no blood or injury detail, impact implied by the cut and sound, the underwater shot as a silhouette in the headlight beams with clothes intact. Some providers may still refuse it; the plan keeps a fallback of a wide underwater shot with Veer small in frame.
findings.blocks: Units u11 to u14; owner approval of the treatment

findings.finding: Yash drives a sports car, but he was a child in 2014 and is therefore about 17 in 2026; India's minimum age for a car licence is 18.
evidence: fact: Yash appears as a child in the 2014 references
findings.proposal: Either state Yash's age as 18 (and Meera's and Raghav's if they are classmates) or make underage driving part of the story. The owner decides; the plan assumes Yash is stated as 18.

findings.finding: Yash's childhood scene was cut from the revised Episode 1, so viewers meet him for the first time behind the wheel.
evidence: fact: the revised Episode 1 removed the post scene with young Yash and young Nikhil
findings.proposal: Add a name card 'YASH' in the Episode 1 card style on his first shot.

findings.finding: Meera's green-stone pendant weakens Veer. It is series-critical and has no reference yet.
evidence: master document: pendant and roti references to approve; track who wears the pendant
findings.proposal: Create the pendant as a locked prop with a close reference before any school-gate unit. Add facts: Meera wears it from Episode 2; why it weakens Veer is an open thread.

findings.finding: Devendra 'calls for a spanner' and Raghav 'calls her over' with no scripted words.
findings.proposal: Proposed lines for approval: Devendra 'वीर, पाना लाना!' and Raghav 'मीरा!'. Otherwise both stay off-mic as ambience.

findings.finding: Suman calls 'from the same kitchen door' while the bus passes the gate, so the kitchen door must face the yard, gate and road.
findings.proposal: Design the Sharma farmhouse so the kitchen door opens onto the yard with the gate and farm road in view; approve the exterior view with the kitchen views.

findings.finding: Ages check out: 2014 plus twelve years is 2026; Veer goes from about 5 to 17; Suman 32 to 44 and Devendra 36 to 48 allow the subtle aging the master document asks for.
Episode 1 showed glowing eyes; Episode 2 shows speed and strength with no glow. This is consistent but adds canon.
evidence: fact: the boy's eyes glowed once at the end of Episode 1
findings.proposal: Add facts at close-out: Veer is fast and strong from childhood; his parents know and hide it; the eye glow has not returned.
